adaptation.compatibility: Additive data module and metadata fixture only; existing v1 records, hashes, exhaustive method/error enums, journals, manifests and package/lock selection unchanged.
adaptation.implemented: Borrow original metadata, bounded exact data reads/replies, checked region bounds, exact byte lengths and actual chunk SHA-256 association; reply evidence also binds original metadata.
adaptation.not_adopted: Live provider, fresh permission port, paid dispatch, extent/progress ledger, transfer completion, automatic outcome/receipt or upload/load/start runner.

coverage_continuation_review.disposition: Committed source only; dirty sibling work remains read-only. Whole-command download and directory presence remain insufficient full-state evidence; no runner code or completion assumptions imported.
coverage_continuation_review.implementation: Local incremental coverage of already admitted replies under exact metadata evidence; three independent cursors and bounded chunk-presence bits. No new record, hash, provider, allowance or IO.
coverage_continuation_review.qualification: Native codec/coverage and original spent-journal/source-reference replay only; authentic transfer, durable byte custody and backend qualification remain separate.

pinned_upstream.license: Registry dependency; no Canic/upstream source copied into production. Existing source provenance and licenses retained.
pinned_upstream.shape: Exact pinned data-kind arguments and one required chunk blob result. Ranges stay inside retained metadata; full chunk hash must be present in metadata.

qualification.membership: Compare registered/passing names; test every actual JSON fixture member rather than fixed aggregate counts.
qualification.native: Wire/hash/bounds and local spent-journal/source-reference reopen only; no IC behavior simulated or qualified.
qualification.remaining: Authenticated association, fresh permissions/per-call authority, aggregate complete data coverage, stable custody, upload/load/application safety and terminal/release admission.

reviewed_sources.disposition: Whole-command download boundary inspected; no process/provider code, per-call accounting assumption or transport imported.
Executor unit-success download result inspected; not adopted as complete transfer evidence.
Consumers of download transition/receipt/interruption evidence inspected. Directory-to-completion assumptions remain unchanged and are not imported.
